name: d1_bluestein
description: Bluestein chirp-Z any-L + UNPADDED RADER at prime L with L-1 pow2 (65537: conv = 2^16 EXACTLY = [4,64,64,4], 7 M-passes -- g^q gather fused into stage 0, kernel multiply in the fused mid, y[g^-m]=x0+conv scatter fused into the last stage with ET0 write prefetch, conv-order chain state so interior chain steps are pure index reversal; PORTED from d1_rader r1-r5, built on this file's own Stockham core): split-complex mixed-radix(2/3/4/5/8/9/15/16/64) Stockham conv core, minimal smooth pad (10007->20480); large M via Agarwal-Cooley coprime 2D conv (CRT, no inter-axis twiddles; minimal-M split over odd 3^a5^b <= 135: 100003->204800=8192x25) with chirp/CRT-fused entry+exit, NT-streamed exit scatter; radix-16/64 two-layer L1-tile stages (d1_rader's) with flavor-specific schedules (rows 1024=[4,64,4] 5 passes, 8192=[4,16,16,8], conv 20480=[4,16,16,5,4]); TILED Good-Thomas radix-15 (L1-bounce, zero inner twiddles) so the M2=135 tile runs [9,15] in 2 passes; fwd-last x kernel-mul x inv-entry fused into ONE pass at last radix 2/4/8; paired-p zmm radix-8 at the narrow s=4 stage; radix-9 tile stages; zero-pruned+chirp-fused entry and pruned chirp-fused exit for small M, NT-streamed for DRAM-bound batched cells; direct Stockham for smooth L with NT batched interleave; dense tiny-L floor; fused map chain with rsqrt/rcp+2NR Newton map; ALL hot tables incl. the CRT rotation table in pre-faulted hugepage mmap blocks with L2-way skew (the last 4K-page table was a measured 1545/1950 us bimodality at 65537)
